# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-255-256 (§§255–256)

Edited in place: `units.json`, `gloss.json` (`t` and word counts untouched; checked by assemble + validate, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 419 words, 75 units).
Totals: 0 critical, 4 major, 13 moderate, 10 minor. Units are numbered 0–74 in file order (U0 = Tendēče …).

Checks that passed unchanged: every word's morph brackets equal the packet's Ming gloss (419/419); gloss.json covers all 258 reader tokens together with the shared glossary, no unused keys, every `__broaden__` entry extends the existing glossary entry; names follow conventions (Qān → Qan, Qaγan → Qahan, Chinggis, Cha'adai, Jüchi, Ögödei, Tolui, Qasar, Alchidai, Ödchigin, Belgütei, Altan and Quchar, Sartaul, Mother Etügen, Eternal Heaven); house phrases (žarliγ bolurun → "issued a decree:", ese/ülü, bolγan "making", reflexive (i) as a separate morph, polite plural -dkün/-dqun).

## Decisions asked for

- **Altan, capital or "golden" (words 349 and 409)**: capital, the Altan = the Jin ruler, in `l`, `i` and morph. Word 349 (`altan arγamži-jan` after `Sartaγ̇ul irgen-e`) is the same phrase as in the published §254 ("the Altan's own leash", Ming 金 "Jin"); the draft's "golden leash" contradicted the sibling part. Word 409 (`altan žiloγ̇a`) carries the same Ming 金 and pairs with the leash as a second item of the Altan's harness, so it follows; both notes name "golden" as the other reading. gloss.json broadens `altan` accordingly.
- **Asha Gambu**: kept. Ašaγambu is built like Žaqaγambu (→ Jaqa Gambu, Ž → J, γambu → Gambu); Aša- → Asha follows the sh rule (Qori-Shilemün, Ashiq). The draft's note ("as with Jaqa Gambu") is right.
- **Qān → Qan / Qaγan → Qahan**: already consistent (`i`: Qan at U0, U9, U14, U67; Qahan elsewhere; `l` keeps Qaγan). No change.

## Findings refused (with reason)

- **Re-cut of U63/U64/U65** so that `či.` ends U63 and `bi.` ends U64: right on Shiratori's punctuation, but `t` and word counts are frozen for this pass. Handled in `i` and notes instead. For the pass-2 reviewer or a re-cut: move word 346 (`či.`) up and word 354 (`bi.`) up.
- U1/U8 etc. "we two are here" (bi-že): "here" is mildly added; harmless, `l` says "are-indeed".
- U4 "sneered" for müčilžežü (Ming 哂 "smile at, scorn"): kept; the note explains.
- U12/U17 "for his part" for lü (Ming 但): uncertain either way and flagged in the notes; kept.
- U10/U11 `i` drops "own" of the reflexive -jan: reading is argued in the notes; kept.
- U13 "put forward" with colon: flagged reading; kept.
- U16 "Speak your own mind": reflexive; flagged uncertain; kept.
- U29 `i` "what was done to them" for ker (Ming 怎 "how"): idiomatic rhetorical question; U30's `l` now keeps the "how".
- U32/U33 "he said," then "he said.": mirrors keġeġed … keġebe; kept.
- U44 "Next:" for Basa (再 "again"): kept.
- U68 "and sent them": object uncertain, discussed in the note.
- Lemma bü- (not bi) for the verb "is": the glossary entry is headed bi, but published parts use both; no change.
- Reflexive (i) as "accusative (Shiratori's)" on participles and nigen(i)-: consistent with the Ming 行 and with earlier parts; kept.
- Apostrophe style in names (Cha’adai curly here, Cha'adai straight in §254): published parts already mix; not touched.
- Stems "inferred from the Ming" (müčilže-, qolbara-, daldari-, osolda-, kelbe-, …): all labelled as inferred and uncertain by the glosser; no modern form invented, none changed.
